svg.title: One Harbour v2, route
svg.desc: The ship's track on the fx 1 plane, one path, monotone in x. Head office edge at x 0, A1 anchorage (1380 1610), A2 abeam the port agent (2140 1620), A3 abeam the DMC (2620 1632), A4 abeam the guide hut (3080 1680), A5 tour boat station (3520 1690), exit at x 4800. Sample it with getTotalLength and getPointAtLength; station fractions are recorded in world.json.
